# Synthetic research workflow fixture

All files in this directory are original synthetic fixtures dedicated to the public domain
under CC0-1.0. No real participants, private data or external paper content are included.
This fixture checks engineering reproducibility; it does not measure scientific quality.

`measurements.csv` contains two groups with arithmetic means 2 and 4.
`experiment.mts` reproduces those means using the declared TypeScript runtime.
`figure.vl.json` plots the frozen values, and `manuscript.tex` records the synthetic result.
`references.bib` and `literature.json` describe the fixture source, not a real publication.
`source.pdf` is a one-page original PDF containing the same values.
`manifest.json` fixes byte hashes; update it explicitly when fixture contents change.
